messages:
lin: opened PR to adjust SOC2-friendly wording for evidence exports and add two concise CLI snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/980
kevin: thanks — can we standardize flag names? prefer --user-identifiers for full exports, and keep --anonymize as default
amy: agree. add clear line: "are redacted by default" and call out that anonymized exports remove stable correlation ids
lin: added both examples:
```bash
redwood export-evidence --since 2024-02-01 --until 2024-02-28 --format jsonl --anonymize

redwood export-evidence --since 2024-02-01 --format jsonl --user-identifiers --auth-token $TOKEN
```
amy: nice. need to say that full exports require an authorized legal request and are logged in the Compliance Audit Trail
legal-team-bot: Reminder: docs that describe returning user-identifiers must be reviewed by @legal-team. Please request review.
link-bot: link-check: internal playbook link flagged as internal-only :warning: — mark internal note before public publish
kevin: add brief TTL note: "Exports respect tenant retention settings; older events are omitted unless a legal_hold is applied."
lin: pushed update, requested legal review, will merge after sign-off and add changelog entry
amy: LGTM pending legal
